topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture series, outlines key themes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment, and presents the learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Drivers in Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tumor progression is driven cell-intrinsically through successive driver mutations, Darwinian clonal selection, and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue differentiation hierarchies and stem-like properties influence tumor initiation, propagation, and clonal dynamics across cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how extrinsic inflammatory stimuli, environmental promoters, and supportive stromal microenvironments cooperate with mutations to enable and maintain malignant growth.

topics.label: Methodologies and Synthesis of the Multi-Factorial Evolutionary Paradigm
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review advanced single-cell and spatial omics technologies used to study tumor heterogeneity and provide a comprehensive synthesis of the multi-factorial nature of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Preview of Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and provides a brief forward look to the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
